description: Ministry of Labour - Appoint Mr. M. M. I. R. A. Jayathilaka No 32/261 Galle, as the Arbitrator to the Industrial Disputes between R. Y. G. S. Gyan Yapa, Colombo 12 and Sri Lanka State Plantation Corporation Colombo 12
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments and legal procedures for dispute resolution, falling clearly within the Legal/Regulatory classification category. While it mentions a government minister (Manusha Nanayakkara), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers under existing legislation rather than announcing personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
